title: Approve POLIS's composition
question: Choose the structure that should govern the complete navigable prototype. Use the steer field if you want elements combined.

options.label: Atlas Cockpit
options.lineage: living map with an attached evidence rail
options.body: The clearest complete application shell: the city dominates, all eight views remain obvious, and one selected agent connects a macro anomaly to a full decision chain. Carry the structure forward, but replace the photoreal map treatment with POLIS's abstract city geometry.

options.label: City Cross-Section
options.lineage: architectural section plus synchronized causal ribbon
options.body: The strongest expression of AI agents living and working inside one civic system. Districts, institutions, agents, macro charts, and the causal chain share a single time cursor. Risk: the cross-section should complement—not replace—the accurate top-down map.

options.label: Trace Lens
options.lineage: urban atlas viewed through a causal microscope
options.body: The most distinctive interaction: a lens reveals district conditions, nearby agents, perception, memory, action, and outcome in concentric layers. It makes macro-to-micro traceability memorable, but is the most technically ambitious and must preserve familiar navigation.
